subject: POC request: trial fuel bridge and temporary rate uplift for high-QPS throughput test
messages:
From: Alicia Park <alicia.park@acmecorp.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 09 Aug 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: trial fuel for high-QPS POC (throughput + latency validation)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to run a 24h stress POC to validate latency and throughput characteristics for a user-facing feature. High level:
- Target sustained RPS: 5k (spikes to 8k for short windows)
- Typical request: 128–256 tokens input, expected 200–400 tokens output
- Measurement: p50/p95/p99 latencies, streaming behavior, and KV cache warmup

We are on the trial account and will need temporary trial fuel + a short-term rate uplift to run the soak. Can Redwood provision a one-off credit top-up and a rate limit increase for the duration of the test? I attached our POC test plan (acme-poc-test-plan.pdf) with load windows and acceptance criteria.

Also looping in our SRE lead (sre@acmecorp.com) to coordinate test windows — Raj will own the run on our side.

Appreciate a quick turnaround, aiming for next Wed (2028-08-16) night window if possible.

Best,
Alicia Park
Head of Product
Acme Corp

Attachment: acme-poc-test-plan.pdf (PDF, 98 KB)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Alicia Park <alicia.park@acmecorp.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 09 Aug 2028 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: trial fuel for high-QPS POC (throughput + latency validation)

Hi Alicia — thanks for the plan and clear acceptance criteria. A few quick clarifying Qs before I route to engineering for scheduling:
- Which model variant do you plan to use for the soak (e.g., small/med/quantized)?
- Do you need logs/trace exports or just token/latency metrics?
- Any egress/data residency constraints for the artifacts we might collect?

We can provision provisional credits and a temporary rate bump while we validate infra. I will coordinate with Marissa on approvals; if you can confirm the model and expected avg seq length I can push an initial allowance today.

Prelim offer: we can provision a 75k token promotional fuel and a temporary rate uplift to 6k RPS for the first 12 hours while we validate. If the test needs the full 24h window or higher sustained RPS we will escalate to an accelerated promo (Marissa is looped).

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm model + seq length + preferred test start time
2) We provision provisional credits and open a shortlived infra ticket for rate uplift
3) On the test day, we add a Redwood on-call to monitor and collect perf traces

—
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Park <alicia.park@acmecorp.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 09 Aug 2028 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: trial fuel for high-QPS POC (throughput + latency validation)

Alicia / team — approved.

We will apply an internal promo called "Trial Accelerant": 100,000 tokens of non-recurring credit and a temporary rate-limit increase to 10k RPS for a single 24-hour window. Notes/constraints:
- The 24-hour rate uplift must be scheduled with our infra team at least 48 hours in advance.
- Redwood will collect perf traces and p95/p99 latency snapshots; those artifacts are shared under our standard POC data handling terms.
- If the test produces abnormal load patterns outside the plan (sustained >10k RPS), Redwood reserves the right to throttle and will notify you immediately.

Karthik: please open the infra ticket and coordinate the exact window. Alicia: attaching the promo approval letter for your records.

Marissa Cole
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: promo-approval-letter.pdf (PDF, 6 KB)

From: Alicia Park <alicia.park@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@acmecorp.com>, SRE Team <sre@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Aug 2028 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: trial fuel for high-QPS POC (throughput + latency validation)

Fantastic — thank you both. 24-hour window confirmed: 2028-08-16 22:00 PDT → 2028-08-17 22:00 PDT. Raj will be the Redwood point-of-contact on our side (raj.patel@acmecorp.com).

We accept the Trial Accelerant terms. Please:
- Provision the 100k token credit today so we can finalize internal signoffs
- Open the infra ticket for the 10k RPS uplift and share the ticket link here
- Add an on-call Redwood engineer to monitor traces (we will share a rendezvous Slack channel)

Thanks again for the fast turnaround — this test is critical for our Q4 rollout timeline. I'll upload a short test-run checklist to the shared Drive and post the link when ready.

Best,
Alicia
